Input available without fieldwork: Existing documents, tables, manuals, policies, PDFs, drawings, notes
What can be verified now: Source identity, date presence, document type, duplicate detection, privacy classification
What still requires accountable review o: Authenticity, legal sufficiency, current site applicability

Input available without fieldwork: Narrative reports, invoices, data sheets, maintenance logs
What can be verified now: Required fields, source links, validity interval, uncertainty-state completeness
What still requires accountable review o: Whether records accurately reflect physical conditions

What can be verified now: Claim-to-evidence linkage, unsupported scope jumps, prohibited conclusion categories
What still requires accountable review o: Scientific, professional, regulatory, or clinical conclusions

Input available without fieldwork: Policies, standards, user needs, equipment narratives
What can be verified now: Unique IDs, ambiguous verbs, missing verification methods, cross-module conflicts
What still requires accountable review o: Requirement approval and contractual or regulatory interpretation

Input available without fieldwork: Site descriptions, plans, inventories, treatment narratives
What can be verified now: Graph connectivity, missing residual segments, absent method/provenance/uncertainty
What still requires accountable review o: Physical layout, actual pathways, transport mechanisms

What can be verified now: Completeness of formula inputs and unknown quantities
What still requires accountable review o: Numerical uncertainty values, calibration and field validation
